target: Observed S-NPP VIIRS equivalent monthly common-grid centroid cell-days, not fire truth
units: VIIRS-equivalent centroid cell-days per complete UTC calendar month
cohort: Explicit exact source/product-version pair per regional experiment; never pooled or relabelled
eligibility: Every UTC date has both request-verified exports, known totals, one exact product-version pair and no documented processing gaps
training_inputs: eligible monthly MODIS and S-NPP counts

partition.forward_selection: inner earlier-training-years-only; at least two earlier years

interval.method: symmetric absolute log1p residuals; finite-sample upper order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9); clip lower count at zero
interval.warning: Empirical calibration, not guaranteed coverage under temporal dependence; baseline separately calibrated on same dates

gates.authority: proposed project gates; not NASA standards; approval required before fitting

report: all twelve complete-month annual errors only
claims_excluded: blind confirmation from previously inspected periods
amendment: Any methodological or gate change requires a new immutable protocol ID, new human approval and reevaluation. Previously inspected inputs remain retrospective.

method_annex.ratio_fit: annual=sum(reference)/sum(MODIS); zero denominator unavailable. Month-specific ratio requires monthly MODIS denominator >=30; otherwise use annual ratio.
method_annex.selection: Monthly minimizes median absolute log1p prediction error, with lexical model-name tie break; inner nested leave-one-training-year-out or inner forward using at least two earlier years. Outer train strictly beforeY-2; calibrationY-2/Y-1; testY.
method_annex.metrics: WAPE=sum(abs(error))/sum(reference); signed relative bias=sum(error)/sum(reference), undefined if denominatorzero. Interval score width+20*miss distance for nominal90%. Log error uses log((prediction+1)/(reference+1)).
method_annex.intervals: Sorted absolute log1p calibration residual, rankceil((n+1)*0.9); require rank<=n. expm1(log1p(point)±radius), lower clippedzero; zero radius preserves exact point; nonzero boundaries rounded outward by nextafter.
method_annex.qualification: All declared project gates apply to both monthly selection strategies; no post-test candidate choice. Synthetic input cannot enter authentic admission. Previously inspected periods are retrospective. Human conclusion/native/task-study gates remain separate.
method_annex.subgroup_interval_reporting: Report exact covered_count and interval_count per test year and season; pooled85%floor is not proof of90%temporal/seasonal/conditional coverage. Calibration requires all four calendar quarters. Zero/small-count support remains explicit.
